country: Pitcairn, Henderson, Ducie, and Oeno Islands
places: Official birthday of King Charles III
Palwala Valley Point on Big Ridge

fields.climate: tropical; hot and humid; modified by southeast trade winds; rainy season (November to March)
fields.terrain: rugged volcanic formation; rocky coastline with cliffs
fields.hazards: occasional tropical cyclones (especially November to March), but generally only heavy tropical storms; landslides
fields.farm: honey; wide variety of fruits and vegetables; goats, chickens; fish
fields.exports: fertilizers, sulfur, refined petroleum, excavation machinery, ethylene polymers
fields.languages: English (official), Pitkern (mixture of an 18th century English dialect and a Tahitian dialect)
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal with three years of residency

holiday.name: Official birthday of King Charles III
holiday.date: usually celebrated the second Saturday in June
